doc: Cloud objects of a patch: mask = patch > 0.5 (strict), scipy.ndimage.label with its default structure, 4-CONNECTIVITY (edge neighbours only: two texels that touch diagonally are two objects; no wraparound), area = texel count * patch_px_km^2 (77.0252 km^2 per texel); returns (share of the cloudy area held by objects larger than 1e5 km^2, median object area in km^2), and (0.0, 0.0) when there is no object. Objects of 1298 and 1299 texels (areas 99978.7 and 100055.7 km^2) on each side of the 1e5 km^2 threshold, plus two single texels: four objects (even count: the median averages the middle two = 649.5 texels), big = 1299 / 2601. Diagnostics recomputed by the case through the same label call, not returned by the function: n_objects and areas_km2 (in ndimage.label order: by the raster position of each object's first texel); a port's labelling must produce the same multiset of areas. Integer counts times a float64 constant: exact up to the rounding of a product and a sum, 1e-9.
